ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is an outline map of China, marking three cotton-producing areas, among which cotton-producing area I is located in the Xinjiang area of China's northwest inland, and cotton-producing area II is located near North China and the Huang-Huai-Hai region. Then reason: the question asks to compare the most obvious advantage of I relative to II in cotton production. Xinjiang is deep inland, has little precipitation, many sunny days, and strong solar radiation; North China and the Huang-Huai-Hai region are affected by the monsoon, with relatively more cloudy and rainy weather. Cotton is a light-loving crop, so the most prominent advantage of area I is good light conditions.
